{{Top|leg}}
'''Puncture-proof pontoons''' were a type of landing gear employed by the [[DeepWater-class light freighter|''DeepWater''-class light freighter]]. It was one of three separate types of landing gear used by the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and allowed the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to land on [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="SS">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>
